AC amendment (gap-analysis F6): Pin Jira key extraction as regex `^jira-([a-z0-9]+)-(\d+)$` (case-insensitive). Match → `f'{group(1).upper()}-{group(2)}'`. Non-matching local_ids skip probe emission (log + skip, NO exception). Test cases REQUIRED:
- 'jira-dig-100' → 'DIG-100'
- 'jira-DIG-100' → 'DIG-100' (idempotent upper)
- 'jira-dig' → SKIPPED (no numeric suffix)
- 'jira-multi-word-100' → SKIPPED with warning (ambiguous multi-segment)
